descriptions.text: Orthrus. Juvenile Gate Guardian. Level 10. This is a bereft pet of Geyrun. Who's a good boy? Who's a good boy? The most loveable hell-hound on this side of Alpha Centari. The left side is for sniffin' and the right side is for lickin' and that pink belly of his? It's for kissin'.

recap.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons reports a deity is taking the landscape apart to search for a pet named Orthrus. Orthrus, a level 10 juvenile gate guardian and fragile puppy, lands in Crawler Carl's bubble. Carl and Princess Donut use a stinking Meat Hooks scroll to lure the building-sized puppy from the water. Crawler Quan Ch attacks Orthrus, but Carl takes Emberus as his god and uses a celestial grenade to bring Emberus to his position. Emberus and Orthrus leave together.

beats.headline: Something outside is looking for a dog
beats.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons reports in from a popped bubble: there is a deity outside, taking the landscape apart, and it is searching. Not hunting crawlers. Searching. The thing it has lost is called Orthrus. Every crawler on this floor is working out how to survive their own bubble, and the largest event on my board is a god who has misplaced a pet.
beats.gist: Elle McGibbons reports a deity is taking the landscape apart to search for a lost pet named Orthrus.

beats.headline: He lands inside the bubble
beats.text: Orthrus is now inside the bubble with Crawler Carl's team, and everyone in there has been handed the Where the Red God Glows quest to go with him. Around the edges of it: Maggie My is loose somewhere up on the bowl, and Princess Donut spends the whole thing trying to keep an enormous two-headed puppy alive. Everyone is very busy. Nobody is looking at the same emergency.
beats.gist: Orthrus lands in the bubble and the team receives the Where the Red God Glows quest.

beats.headline: The one god down here who can die
beats.text: The file on him, since he is going to matter. Orthrus is a juvenile gate guardian, level 10, kid brother to the three-headed one who guards a stairwell exit a long way below this one. He was on course to become a vicious, baby-eating, nun-defiling murder machine, and then in a single day his master was murdered and he was pulled into the Nothing. Most things the Nothing touches come out ruined. He came out unaffected, because he is too innocent for it to take hold, and fire does nothing to him at all. Here is the line that matters to a crawler: unlike other gods, he is not invulnerable. He is a puppy. Happy, destructive, rambunctious, roly-poly, very pokey. Fragile.
beats.gist: Orthrus is a level 10 juvenile gate guardian and a fragile, pokey puppy who can die.

beats.headline: Two quests, pointing opposite ways
beats.text: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut take an aeroplane up and read Meat Hooks, a scroll whose stench brings every carnivorous pet in range running, to lure a puppy the size of a building out of the water and out of the bubble. The quest that comes with it is simple: bring Orthrus to Emberus. Then a second quest is announced, and this one pays crawlers for killing him. Both are on the board together, which is a design decision somebody made and I am obliged to run. Crawler Quan Ch reads the second one and attacks the puppy.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut use a stench-filled Meat Hooks scroll to lure Orthrus, a building-sized puppy, to Emberus.

beats.headline: Collected
beats.text: The aeroplane spirals down with Quan Ch closing in on Crawler Carl. Carl takes Emberus as his god mid-fall and throws a celestial grenade, the god arrives at his position, and for a short while nothing on this floor can touch him. Then Emberus finds Orthrus. The two of them go, together, and the floor is left to the people who were fighting over a dog.
beats.gist: Emberus finds Orthrus and they leave together after Carl throws a celestial grenade.
